record.issue_text: [BUG] In sharing mode zohoCrmTokenInfo is a raw fetch Response, so zohoCrmTokenInfo.data is undefined and reading .error on it throws TypeError. Every Zoho CRM token refresh fails in sharing deployments, breaking Zoho CRM calendars whenever the sync feature is enabled.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `refreshOAuthTokens()` which, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, returns a raw `fetch()` `Response` object (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). In `packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path assigns `const zohoCrmTokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then immediately reads `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error`. A `fetch` Response has no `.data`, so in sharing mode this becomes `undefined` and accessing `.error` will throw a `TypeError`, breaking token refresh.
